flora: Cycadophytes (stout, barrel-shaped trunks covered in diamond-patterned leaf scars)
Stiff, crown-like rosettes of leathery, pinnate fronds
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; trunk proportions should feel chunky, squat, and toy-like; fronds have a thick, waxy, plastic-like rigidity with smooth, rounded tip leaflets; no sharp, paper-thin textures.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range view of several mature Cycadophytes grouped on a volcanic terrace. Their heavy crowns of dark green leaves spread out horizontally, frame-focusing on a massive central seed cone.
visual_logic.ground: Cracked, dark gray basaltic earth dusted with lighter ochre silt and littered with dry, amber-colored leaf fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright, direct midday sun causing a strong waxy specular highlight across the upper surface of the stiff fronds.
